description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the JobCategoryService component in the OrangeHRM system. It contains test methods for retrieving job categories and fetching a specific job category by ID, using mocks and test data.

classes.name: JobCategoryServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the JobCategoryService, testing methods for listing job categories and retrieving a job category by ID.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by initializing the service and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testGetJobCategoryList
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of the job category list from the service with mocked DAO.

methods.name: testGtJobCategoryById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific job category by ID from the service with mocked DAO.
